hypothesis: Because the product-form cut saturates on high-fanout nets and the critical-pair cross-tier statistic correlates negatively with score, we add a *soft-range* (logsumexp-style) penalty on the spread of p within each net, normalized by pin count and by a case-relative criticality weight — this penalizes nets whose pins are split across tiers more smoothly than the saturating product, with criticality weighting capped so hub nets do not dominate.
